Welcome to the redesigned Zhang Lab website.

The relaunch brings a new visual identity in MSU maroon and gold, a
data-driven [People](../people.qmd) page, our full
[publication record](../publications.qmd), and this news feed — where we'll
share papers, awards, and lab milestones.

The site remains open source on
[GitHub](https://github.com/lz245/lz245.github.io). If something looks off or
is hard to use, [tell us](mailto:l.zhang@msstate.edu) — accessibility feedback
is always welcome.
